questions: What changes does helix-cli need to support GOAL mode ticket creation?

answers.answer: Minimal scope: (1) Add 'GOAL' to VALID_MODES const array at src/tickets/create.ts line 13, (2) Update usage string at line 17, (3) Update help text in src/tickets/index.ts, (4) Update documentation in src/docs/cli-content.ts. Mode validation (lines 79-88) normalizes to uppercase and uses includes check — no logic changes needed. Mode is conditionally included in request body (line 147) — no structural changes. Goal-specific fields (e.g., maxChildren) are not needed at CLI creation time for MVP.
evidence: src/tickets/create.ts lines 79-88: uppercase normalization, includes validation
src/tickets/create.ts line 147: mode conditionally included in request body
Scout reference-map.json (helix-cli): 1 code change + 3 doc string updates

statement: The CLI needs a trivial extension: add GOAL to the VALID_MODES array and update 3 usage/documentation strings. No structural or validation logic changes required. Goal-specific creation fields (maxChildren) are deferred — the server API will handle defaults.
